title: NIST WebBook: Ethylene is C2H4, molecular weight 28.0532 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Ethylene as C2H4, molecular weight 28.0532 amu, CAS 74-85-1.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Ethylene, CAS Registry Number 74-85-1, lists molecular formula C2H4 and molecular weight 28.0532 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 28.0313001 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C2H4/c1-2/h1-2H2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
